title: KTAG — Student Systems
hook: A growing suite of management systems for Kolej Tan Sri Aisyah Ghani, UPM.
text: I have had the opportunity to develop several systems for Kolej Tan Sri Aisyah Ghani (KTAG) UPM, including the DapurSiswa Management System and a booking system. It has been a genuine pleasure to work alongside a group of young, visionary students who are passionate about bringing their ideas to life through technology.
highlights: Multiple systems delivered, including DapurSiswa management and booking.
Built in collaboration with the student team behind the vision.
Scoped around how the college actually operates, not a demo brief.

systems.name: DapurSiswa Management System
systems.summary: Management system for the college's DapurSiswa programme.

systems.name: Booking System
systems.summary: A booking system for the college.

coverAlt: The DapurSiswa console for KTAG, showing an overview dashboard with booking volume, volunteer hours and quick actions.

caseStudy.problem: The college needed software that fit the way its students actually run things — not a generic system that would be abandoned after handover.
caseStudy.approach: I worked directly with the student team to scope each system, then built and delivered them as separate pieces: DapurSiswa management and booking.
caseStudy.outcome: The systems are live for KTAG, and the relationship continues as new operational needs surface.
caseStudy.learned: Client work is mostly translation: turning a lived operational problem into a specification, then into software people will actually use.
